entries.title: I Chronicles 20:1
segments:
Rabbah; the capital of the Ammonites. 
 
  Tarried at Jerusalem; that is, as explained in

, till Joab sent for him, when he had nearly completed the conquest of the Ammonites. 
 
Reference to the sin of David in the matter of Uriah, which took place while Joab was besieging Rabbah, is here entirely omitted; and it is always proper to be silent about the sins of other, unless the cause of God and of truth requires the mention of them.

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:3
segments: Brought out the people; see note on

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:4
segments:
Gezer; a city in the western part of the tribe of Ephraim, bordering upon the Philistines. 
 
This is a world of trial, and one trouble will succeed another through the whole journey of life.  But to those who honor God in their trials, he will at last grant a complete and glorious deliverance.

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:6
segments: Gath; a city of the Philistines.
